title: Publish first identity seed without replacement race
description: Security/correctness review finding in rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs: save_private_seed checks absence then uses rename, which can overwrite a final id.seed created by a concurrent daemon between the check and rename. Publish with atomic no-replace semantics and fail closed if the destination appears.
close_reason: Fixed: save_private_seed split into stage_private_seed (symlink_metadata pre-check + create_new 0600 temp, O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC on Linux) and publish_private_seed via fs::hard_link = atomic no-replace; concurrent appearance of id.seed fails closed with AlreadyExists, rival preserved, temp cleaned. Test identity_seed_publish_fails_closed_when_destination_appears_concurrently proves it. 12/12 lichend tests pass.
